clauses.name: Rent Amount and Payment Terms
clauses.description: Monthly rent, due date, accepted payment methods, grace period

high: No clear rent amount specified
Rent can be changed unilaterally at any time
medium: No grace period for late payment
low: Clear fixed rent with reasonable payment terms

clauses.name: Security Deposit
clauses.description: Deposit amount, conditions for deductions, return timeline

high: Deposit exceeds typical local norms significantly
No return timeline specified
Vague or unlimited deduction reasons
medium: Return timeline longer than typical norms
low: Clear deposit amount within typical range with specific return timeline and deduction criteria

clauses.name: Lease Term and Renewal
clauses.description: Duration of lease, renewal terms, auto-renewal provisions

high: Auto-renewal with no opt-out mechanism or very short notice window
No defined term
medium: Auto-renewal with short opt-out notice period
low: Clear fixed term with reasonable renewal options

clauses.name: Termination and Notice Period
clauses.description: How either party can end the lease, required notice periods

high: Landlord can terminate with no notice or very short notice
Tenant has no right to early termination
Asymmetric notice requirements heavily favoring landlord
medium: Notice period is unusually long for tenant
low: Balanced termination rights with reasonable notice periods

clauses.name: Maintenance and Repairs
clauses.description: Who is responsible for what repairs and maintenance

high: Tenant responsible for all repairs including structural
No obligation for landlord to maintain habitability
low: Clear division with landlord responsible for structural/major and tenant for minor

clauses.name: Subletting and Assignment
clauses.description: Whether and how the tenant can sublet or transfer the lease

high: Absolute prohibition on subletting with no exception
medium: Subletting requires landlord consent with no 'not unreasonably withheld' language
low: Subletting allowed with reasonable consent provisions

clauses.name: Utilities and Services
clauses.description: Who pays for utilities, what services are included

high: Ambiguous utility responsibility that could lead to disputes
medium: Tenant responsible for all utilities with no caps

clauses.name: Late Fees and Penalties
clauses.description: Fees for late rent payment, bounced checks, other penalties

high: Excessive late fees (e.g., >10% of rent)
Compounding penalties
No grace period before penalties apply
medium: Late fees on the higher end of typical range
low: Reasonable late fees with adequate grace period

clauses.name: Landlord Access and Entry
clauses.description: When and how the landlord can enter the premises

high: Landlord can enter at any time without notice
No restrictions on entry
medium: Notice period shorter than typical norms
low: Reasonable notice required (24+ hours) with specified valid reasons

clauses.name: Insurance Requirements
clauses.description: Required renter's insurance or other insurance obligations

high: Tenant required to carry excessive insurance coverage
medium: Mandatory renter's insurance with high minimum coverage

clauses.name: Pet Policy
clauses.description: Whether pets are allowed, restrictions, additional deposits/fees

high: Non-refundable pet deposit that is excessive
low: Reasonable pet policy with clear terms

clauses.name: Dispute Resolution
clauses.description: How disputes are resolved — mediation, arbitration, litigation

high: Mandatory binding arbitration with landlord choosing arbitrator
Tenant waives right to jury trial
Disputes must be resolved in distant jurisdiction
medium: Mandatory arbitration but with neutral arbitrator selection
low: Mediation first, then standard legal process in local jurisdiction

clauses.name: Governing Law
clauses.description: Which jurisdiction's laws govern the agreement

high: Governing law is a jurisdiction far from the property location
low: Governing law matches the property location
